claims.claim: Tesla produced 464391 vehicles and delivered 486532 in Q3 2026 with 13.7 GWh energy storage deployments.
claims.episode_span: Tesla produced four hundred sixty-four thousand three hundred ninety-one vehicles and delivered four hundred eighty-six thousand five hundred thirty-two in the third quarter. Energy storage deployments reached thirteen point seven gigawatt hours.
claims.source_title: Tesla Q3 2026 Production, Deliveries, and Energy Storage Update
claims.supporting_quote: Production: 464,391 Deliveries: 486,532 Energy storage deployments: 13.7 GWh

claims.claim: Tesla filed patent US 2026/0299533 A1 for the E7M7 15-bit numeric format using 7 exponent and 7 mantissa bits.
claims.episode_span: Tesla filed patent US 2026/0299533 A1 for an E7M7 fifteen-bit numeric format that uses seven exponent bits and seven mantissa bits.
claims.source_title: Tesla's E7M7 Numeric Format Explained (Patent US 2026/0299533 A1)
claims.supporting_quote: Tesla's answer in patent US 2026/0299533 A1 is E7M7: a custom 15-bit format that strips away unneeded exponent bloat while preserving exact training precision

claims.claim: Emergency Drive Away can cause up to $25000 damage to a Supercharger and requires a mandatory service visit.
claims.episode_span: The feature can cause up to twenty-five thousand dollars in damage to the Supercharger and requires a mandatory service visit for the charge port.
claims.source_title: Tesla might charge you up $25,000 if you use its latest feature
claims.supporting_quote: Tesla says its new “Emergency Drive Away” feature can do up to $25,000 in damage to a Supercharger every time someone uses it, and the car needs a mandatory service visit too.
